g.data-storage: 40 GB SAS HDD, 4 GB eUSB flash
g.title: a9k-rsp

rect.data-description: the disk 0 carrier panel, read off the master. Cisco names the media in its lamp table - this card has both an HDD and a CF lamp - but no document in the intake says which panel is which, so the two are identified by position against the lamp column above them and that is an inference, not a citation.

the disk 1 carrier panel, read off the master. Cisco names the media in its lamp table - this card has both an HDD and a CF lamp - but no document in the intake says which panel is which, so the two are identified by position against the lamp column above them and that is an inference, not a citation.

the four-character 5x7 LED dot-matrix display. What it shows is a message vocabulary - the guide gives it two sections, boot-stage/runtime and CAN bus controller errors - not a lamp state list, so it is a display and not an indicator.

circle.data-description: Power Fail (FAIL). Red: standby power fail; the LED is turned off by the CAN bus controller once it is up and running. Off: standby power is normal.
Synchronization (SYNC). Green: system timing is synchronized to an external source. Amber: system timing is free running. Off: no system timing is configured.
Critical Alarm (CRIT). Red: a critical alarm has occurred.
Internal Hard Disk Drive (HDD). Green: the hard disk is busy/active, driven by the SAS controller.
Major Alarm (MAJ). Red: a major alarm has occurred.
External Compact Flash (CF). Green: Compact Flash is busy/active.
Minor Alarm (MIN). Amber: a minor alarm has occurred.
Alarm Cutoff (ACO). Amber: alarm cutoff has been enabled - the ACO push button was pressed after at least one alarm occurred.
the LAMP TEST momentary push button.
